name: Joe's Jeans
why: The missing member of the LA premium-denim cluster — founded 2001, fit-first, on the same dept-store wall as PAIGE and AG.
origin: Joe Dahan, Los Angeles, 2001 — a fit-obsessed denim line from the golden era of LA premium denim; now under Centric Brands.
opview: Fit as the whole argument — the founding pitch.

notes.denim: LA premium denim, first wave — the Asher as the modern slim

cities: Dept stores & denim boutiques · two own shops in California
